The universal elliptic-curve statement is applied to the same actual quadratic twist E^h/Q at both invocations of forward-rank. Nonzero normalized L_*(h) implies L(E^h,1) nonzero because the retained period and omitted factors are nonzero. Modularity, rank0/full Sha finiteness and then full two-primary Selmer corank0 are consumed in that order; no converse or new local bound is asserted.
